subject: Harbor Family Clinic new-patient form
body:
Hi love,

The clinic texted again: your new-patient form has to be done before Thursday's 10:15 visit. Here's what I put on mine so you can copy it:

Address: 27 Linden Terrace, Unit 3, Somerville, Massachusetts 02143
Home phone (landline): (617) 555-0175
Your cell: (617) 555-0141

You were born Aug 9, 1987. Their old chart had 1978, so make sure it's right this time.

Put me down as your emergency contact (spouse), my cell is (617) 555-0129.

Preferred language: English for both of us. And you said you'd rather they text you than call, so pick text.

xx
Ines

--
Ines Lindqvist
Senior Architect, Fairmount Design Group
